messages:
Lydia Park: Heads-up: NimbusPay requested a 10-day POC to validate a compat proxy for their current vendor API. Requirements: preserve billing token counts, match stop-token semantics, and complete their security questionnaire. Can eng + security scope?

Omar Farouk: I can lead the POC. Need customer canonical prompts (30) + ~10 failure cases. Also confirm latency SLO; they asked for p95 <= 250ms.

Hannah Lee: Tokenization mismatch is the main risk. Options: run their tokenizer in the shim (accurate, CPU cost) or apply normalization heuristics (cheaper, may not be exact). For exact billing parity we should run their tokenizer.

Caleb Ruiz: Ops: if we run their tokenizer in the adapter, expect extra CPU and slight latency bump. We'll offer a hosted-adapter surcharge or dedicated pool. Also need their staging allowlist and desired log export (they asked for token-count logs to their S3).

Lydia Park: They want token-for-token parity for finance. Omar, can you provide a minimal curl shim example we can give them?

Omar Farouk: Sure — simple example mapping vendor params -> Redwood and echoing X-Request-Id:

```bash
curl -X POST https://shim.nimbus.stage/api/v1/completions
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <NIMBUS_POC_KEY>"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"prompt":"Summarize invoice 777","length":64,"stop":["\n\n"],"temp":0.0}'
```

Hannah Lee: We'll include deterministic mode (seeded) for parity tests and produce a CSV diff (prompt_id, vendor_text, redwood_text, token_delta, sim_score). Thresholds: token_delta_rate <= 1%, median latency <= 140ms, p95 <= 250ms.

Caleb Ruiz: sec-bot: provisioning sandbox 'nimbus-poc-05' (sbx-142). Credentials uploaded to vault.

Lydia Park: Action items: Omar to produce harness + repo link, Hannah to draft secQ answers/SOC2 snippet, Caleb to post allowlist & S3 export ops. Target: sandbox ready in 48h.

Hannah Lee: I'll start drafting the secQ responses now. Omar please ask NimbusPay for the 30 canonical prompts and 10 failure cases.
